presence_rationale: Substantive climate stress-test disclosure: Group climate scenario analysis with 2 NGFS scenarios (Delayed Transition + Current Policies), BNZ participation in RBNZ 2023 Climate Stress Test (Too Little Too Late scenario, 2023-2050 period). Climate Measurement Standards Initiative participation. ASFI working groups participation.
specificity_rationale: Names 2 NGFS scenarios, RBNZ 'Too Little, Too Late' (TLTL) climate stress scenario, Shared Socioeconomic Pathway 2 (SSP2), Phase III NGFS scenarios, Reserve Bank of New Zealand stress test design (2C from pre-industrial), Australian Sustainable Finance Institute (founding member), CMSI Addendum to Science Report, UNEP FI TCFD programme transition plan capacity-building, Institute for the Future of Business with Melbourne University.
quantification_rationale: Reports portfolio carbon-price ranges per scenario (USD37-144 for Delayed Transition, USD16-62 for Current Policies). Customer-level analysis carbon prices (USD0.63-USD497 for delayed). Scenario warming outcomes (1.6C / 3C+). However, no G-SIB or D-SIB score, no CET1 / capital ratio numbers, no LCR/NSFR — these live in NAB Annual Report Pillar 3, not this Climate Report. SASB FN-CB-550a.2 substantively covered through CST disclosure.
